issues: Fixed width: 850px on .wrapper exceeds 360px viewport width.
Fixed width: 765px attribute on <video> prevents responsive scaling.
Horizontal scrollbar appears; speed controller bar is clipped off-screen.

decision: Update 28 - Video Speed Controller/style.css to make .wrapper fluid with max-width: 850px, make video scale to 100% of available space with height: auto, and preserve the side-by-side speed bar so both 360px and 1280px widths render without horizontal overflow or clipped controls.
